name: Fluorescent terminator sequencing
summary: DuPont researchers put four different fluorescent dyes on the chain-stopping nucleotides themselves, so one reaction mixture produced colour-coded fragments read automatically.
description: Prober and colleagues combined four dye-labelled dideoxy terminators with reverse transcriptase, one reaction mixture, electrophoresis and automated sequence calls.
tier_reason: Retain my promotion: the genome production account credits dye terminators, so it should not sit below primer labelling without an impact reason. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.
